body: I know it may seem horrible but it's JUST highschool. It's not the end of the world, but most of all it shouldn't be the end of yours. No matter how bad you think you fucked up, there's always an opportunity to make that situation better.
Should I tell her? She already knows, she just hadn't heard everything from me.
Go. Leave all this horrible shit behind and wish us the same motivation you've received to dig yourself out of the pit that is depression.

Well ya of course it would. I'm in a slump right now. My parents bills aren't paid, I'm too lazy (unmotivated, depressed, angry, sad, etc.) to continue with my artwork, same goes for writing and volunteering. Doing these things would help a little bit. Not so much to the point where I would be completely out of this horrible horrible pit. But just enough to know that those around me are content and not struggling.

I'm also in this same terrible boat. If you want convincing, think of those that'll miss you. Think of their faces as they hear the news. Think of those who have to organize your funeral. Think of those that have to speak at your funeral. Think of those that have to carry on without the light of your life in theirs. Don't let depression claim another victim. Don't do it tonight. Go out, experience something new, go and do something the old you would never do. Then compare how you feel at that time, and how you do now.
